verdict.comment: This is a tricky choice but HEBRIDEAN NOMAD gets the vote ahead of Currumbin and Diamond Bay.

comments.cardano: Wolverhampton win (1m6f, AW) in March latest; last year he did much better on AW than turf
comments.currumbin: Went badly off boil on turf last year at about 1m; did well at 1m6f/2m this winter on AW
comments.diamondbay: 5lb lower than on his latest turf start; a form case can be made, including on a C&D third
comments.gooloogong: Won a 2m2f hurdle at Fontwell in November when last seen; not dismissed on this return
comments.haaland: This should be a competitive mark; ran only twice on turf, without a serious impact
comments.hebrideannomad: Most recent AW efforts give him a shout if he's as effective on this turf debut
comments.junkanoo: Two encouraging runs on AW (1m3f/2m) in January/February, making late headway
comments.lincolnrockstar: Five wins last year; more to prove at 1m6f than 1m4f but has a good first-time-out record
comments.macari: Below form back on Flat (1m4f, good to firm) latest and he's unraced beyond 1m4f on Flat
comments.onecooldreamer: New trip may now be worth a go, despite pedigree, and he's relatively lightly raced
comments.sixpack: Last of 14 at Chelmsford (1m6f; 8-1) two weeks ago on AW/stable debut; headgear returns

races.raceComment: macari is marginally preferred with a score of 48.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive and more reliable profile over currumbin. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Musselburgh seems to bring out the best in DOOMSDAY nowadays and he's taken to add to his C&D win two starts ago.

comments.birdofplay: Returned from absence in January; unable to make an impact in his five runs this year
comments.coconutbay: Went close behind Doomsday over C&D last month; two lesser runs since but not ruled out
comments.colourcode: Her mark continues to tumble but she struggled last year; eyeshield joins the hood
comments.dandylichious: Runner-up at Catterick last month but well beaten either side and has 1-24 strike-rate
comments.doomsday: Won over C&D on reappearance and he's firmly in calculations now back here
comments.ignaclamar: Won on AW two starts ago but well beaten since and he's 0-15 on turf
comments.keepmestable: Running well in defeat on Newcastle AW in March and won on turf last August; in the mix
comments.purplemartini: Beaten a long way over C&D on final two runs last season but has good C&D form otherwise
comments.tickets: Exploited lower turf mark at Redcar recently & remains well treated on this year's AW form

races.raceComment: doomsday is marginally preferred with a score of 53.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more progressive over coconutbay. verdict.comment: Code Purple ran well from a tough draw here last month but ROCK MELODY is taken to step forward from her reappearance outing.

comments.capitalguarantee: Impressive at Catterick on return (well backed; had wind op over the winter); 2lb well in
comments.codepurple: He's been saving his best for this track of late and ran well over 1m last month; solid
comments.infinityblue: Improved on the Flat last year; hurdle career quickly shelved; contender for in-form yard
comments.jenni: Over 3l behind Capital Guarantee when third at Catterick latest; work to do to turn tables
comments.mysteryofthesands: Promising return to action at Thirsk last month; better expected with that behind him
comments.pallaslord: In fine form on AW this year but he fluffed his lines back on turf last month
comments.ramondiloria: Unpenalised for Monday's Ayr win (6f); up in class but comes here in top form
comments.rockmelody: Conditions should suit and she's down in class with her reappearance effort behind her

races.raceComment: ramondiloria is marginally preferred with a score of 55.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over pallaslord. Won 2 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: It might be worth chancing GO GO GERONIMO, who is well suited by a marathon trip on good ground. Law Of Gold is second choice.

comments.amronssage: Won 4m point on soft ground in February; shade disappointing on good ground next time
comments.assassinslullaby: Made the frame in two 3m4f points this year but looks up against it in this company
comments.aufleuron: Four-time Irish point winner in 2024; struggled at the Festival on stable debut in March
comments.blagthebookies: Came good with two recent point wins; not ruled out each-way on rules return
comments.django: Third in this last year; not at best this year but came second in a recent point
comments.diderovallis: Made the frame in Taunton hunter chase in February but is nothing like the force of old
comments.doctorfoley: Low-grade handicap winner last spring; pulled up in both points this year
comments.dropflight: Mostly out of form under rules last season and last of three finishers in recent 4m point
comments.dusart: Won a minor point in March but has basically become very disappointing
comments.frontalassault: Made low-key hunter chase debut in February; second in three small-field points since
comments.gogogeronimo: Largely consistent and suited by a marathon trip on good ground; might be the answer
comments.herecomesmccoy: Dual slow-ground handicap winner last year; changed hands after poor run in January
comments.hungjury: Showed minor promise in two maiden hurdles for new yard; hiked up in trip for chase debut
comments.jefferyscross: Fair handicapper who recently drew clear to make a winning hunter chase debut at Ludlow
comments.lawofgold: Won this by 16l in 2023 and has mostly been in good form in points this year; respected
comments.mythbuster: Ran a big race in defeat in 4m1f open point last month; shortlisted
comments.nortonhill: Won open point over 3m4f on good ground in March; could have a say here
comments.redmaple: Made all for two easy point wins this spring (3m/3m6f); considered
comments.rockofstar: Fair handicap chaser at best; fell on only appearance last season
comments.vivalavilla: Well beaten in two recent points; difficult to enthuse over here

races.raceComment: lawofgold is confidently preferred with a score of 60.9%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over herecomesmccoy. Won 1 of last 2 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 15 wins from 28 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 15/30 at cheltenham. Key attributes include superior ratings and strong course form and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside position advantageous around left-handed bends

verdict.comment: The lightly raced 4yo SAVVY KINGDOM is taken to build on his reappearance effort and win for a second time.

comments.barleybrown: Multiple C&D winner but this looks a tough assignment; place claims at best.
comments.chuzzlewit: C&D winner last spring, when 16lb higher; best effort this year was over C&D in March.
comments.clearangel: 6f course and 1m turf winner; entitled to need his reappearance; not written off.
comments.edenstorm: Dual 7f AW winner; on the slide for a while and not sure he'll be ending his losing run.
comments.haleend: C&D winner; competitive mark; if straighter for his return run he has each-way potential.
comments.liveaid: 1m Tapeta winner latest; improving and has finished second over C&D; should go well again.
comments.mrmistoffelees: Several creditable runs for this trainer, including second here in March; each-way player.
comments.savvykingdom: 7f AW winner; made eyecatching return from a lengthy absence latest; possible player.
comments.westernesse: C&D winner; well beaten next time; return to a stiffer mile should suit

races.raceComment: westernesse is marginally preferred with a score of 53.9%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over barleybrown. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard ground from 7 attempts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Course specialist TASEVER (nap) is a big player if he can bounce back from a disappointing run at Southwell last month.

comments.benacre: On long losing run but he went close at Musselburgh on penultimate run; not ruled out
comments.bobbyjoeleg: 16-time winner but he's been quiet in last three runs and needs to rediscover his spark
comments.daringlegend: On dangerous mark but he needs a major revival with cheekpieces added
comments.leadman: Solid record for Andrew Balding and he looks interesting back in a handicap for new yard
comments.onenightthunder: Not solid on his form for current yard and has something to prove after 405 days off
comments.projectgeofin: Dual course winner and he ran well on seasonal return last year; one to keep an eye on
comments.tasever: Flopped at Southwell latest but has form figures of 14122322 here since January; respected
comments.toomuch: C&D win in March and was long way out of the weights latest; in the mix back down in grade

races.raceComment: tasever is marginally preferred with a score of 53.9%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over bobbyjoeleg. Placed in 5 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Perhaps MAKEEN may be the one. He has won first time out and, with his trainer's runners in good form, a chance is taken on him.

comments.cubanfiesta: 0-12; two creditable C&D efforts recently; visor back on and drops 1lb; could go close.
comments.damisa: Poor form in all three starts last year; can only watch on his reappearance.
comments.desertraider: 7f/1m AW winner; below his latest winning mark so an upturn in fortunes is not ruled out.
comments.harrymagnus: 7f winner; down the field in two runs since latest wind surgery; hard to see him winning.
comments.madameplaintiff: 7f turf winner; changed hands for 3,000euros since latest start; not written off.
comments.makeen: Placed over C&D; has won when fresh and trainer among the winners; market check advised.
comments.mengtian: 7f and 8.5f Tapeta winner; below par last two starts; competitive mark but is unreliable.
comments.popfavorite: Prolific C&D winner, including latest, but has never followed up; hugely respected.

races.raceComment: popfavorite is marginally preferred with a score of 50.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over mengtian. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: The suggestion is ASADJUMEIRAH, who was not far away last time and may be capable of tipping the scales in his favour.

comments.asadjumeirah: Multiple C&D winner; latest was when 5lb lower and he's been competitive since; contender.
comments.athollblairboy: Prolific C&D winner; placed over C&D when 1lb lower earlier in the year; not ruled out.
comments.blackcurrent: C&D winner; just held over C&D when 1lb higher in February; each-way claims at his best.
comments.flashthedash: C&D winner; beaten over 4l (7f) here from this mark latest but not ruled out down in trip.
comments.flaviustitus: Six-time C&D winner; 9lb lower than latest win; not written off back down in trip.
comments.mayremain: Recent form inconsistent but if producing his optimum he has each-way claims.
comments.poet: Hard to recommend on what he's shown in just two starts in the last couple of seasons.
comments.roguethunder: 6f and 7f winner; handy mark; well held latest and has a bit to prove at this track.
comments.spartanfighter: Six-time C&D winner; on a competitive mark and over his preferred trip; not written off.
comments.thegayblade: Inconsistent; back on last winning mark, so may be capable of making more impact again.
comments.tommytwohoots: 6f winner; third in C&D classified event in February; well beaten last twice; more needed.
comments.woodrafff: Moderate form; dam half-sister to 6f winners, so drop in trip possible plus; market check.

races.raceComment: flaviustitus is marginally preferred with a score of 52.9%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over roguethunder. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
